response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, distributed systems, and technical leadership, with strong hands-on coding skills and contributions to open-source projects. However, his background leans more toward general software engineering and AI-agent infrastructure rather than deep experimentation systems, growth platforms, or enterprise-scale measurement frameworks. His lack of explicit mention of experimentation platforms, feature-flagging, or statistical methods for growth systems raises concerns about direct fit for the role.
strengths: 12+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals and leadership roles
Proven ability to design systemic solutions and optimize performance in distributed systems
Experience with AI tools and developer tooling, showing adaptability to modern technologies
concerns: Limited direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature-flagging, or growth systems
No explicit mention of statistical methods, bias detection, or rollout-risk management for experimentation
Resume emphasizes general software development and AI-agent work over growth/experimentation systems
